sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: Rules and recorded decisions controlling which changes are accepted.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: A shared notebook needs rules for adding and correcting important conclusions.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: A new assertion remains a proposal until the authorized review path accepts it.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Proposal → validation → approval/rejection separates candidates from canonical knowledge.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: It protects evidence, authorization boundaries and decision history.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: Action execution has a separate authorized adapter boundary. Approval alone does not perform an external mutation.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.body: Open the checked implementation, tests, contracts and migrations below. These links identify evidence, not new verification.
